summary: OpenAI's CEO announced that GPT-6 Astra is now available in the API and to Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in Work/Codex, with rollout to Plus and Business users to follow.

practices.reason: A team building on OpenAI's API should update to account for the newly available GPT-6 Astra model and plan for the staged rollout to remaining tiers.
practices.quote: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in Work/Codex, and is available in the API.

notable_reason: This is the first public confirmation of GPT-6 Astra's availability, a named next-generation model from OpenAI, which sector watchers would want to know about even without capability detail.
